name: HitPay
line: Payment gateway with payment links, recurring charges and commerce tools.

free.text: No setup or monthly fee in Singapore, Malaysia and Philippines

cells.countries: Seven local markets; wider Stripe country list differs

fee.math: US sellers are supported through Stripe. Processing depends on Stripe's pricing, plus HitPay's 0.5% fee.
